title: Intelligent Base Station Deployment in Urban Wireless Networks: A Geographic Data-Informed Digital Twin Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.14599v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The placement of base station (BS) is a fundamental determinant of coverage and capacity of urban wireless networks. Yet large-scale BS deployment optimization remains challenging due to its dependency on site-specific radio propagation and user spatial distributions, both of which are unfortunately difficult to obtain prior to deployment. To overcome this barrier, we propose an intelligent BS deployment framework that integrates a geographic data-informed wireless network digital twin (DT) with deep reinforcement learning (DRL), enabling sample-free macro BS deployment optimization from solely open geographic data, without on-site measurements, real user trajectories, or exhaustive ray tracing. translated_title: 城市无线网络中的智能基站部署：一种基于地理数据驱动的数字孪生方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14599v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基站（BS）的放置是决定城市无线网络覆盖范围和容量的基本因素。然而，大规模基站部署优化仍然具有挑战性，因为它依赖于特定地点的无线电传播和用户空间分布，而这些在部署前往往难以获取。为了克服这一障碍，我们提出了一种智能基站部署框架，该框架将地理数据驱动的无线网络数字孪生（DT）与深度强化学习（DRL）相结合，使得仅从开放地理数据中即可实现无样本的宏基站部署优化，无需现场测量、真实用户轨迹或详尽的光线追踪。所提出的数字孪生结合了具有混合输入表示的无样本无线电地图预测模型，以实现毫秒级公里尺度信号强度估计，并辅以基于扩散的生成模型用于轨迹合成。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合地理数据驱动的数字孪生与深度强化学习的智能基站部署框架，仅利用开放地理数据即可实现无样本、无现场测量的高效宏基站部署优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an intelligent base station deployment framework integrating a geographic data-informed digital twin with deep reinforcement learning, enabling sample-free and measurement-free macro BS deployment optimization using only open geographic data.
